newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finns less negative on nuclear power - poll.
newsitem.headline: Finns less negative on nuclear power - poll.

text.p: A new opinion poll shows more Finns are positive about nuclear power than they were a year ago, Finergy, the central organisation of the energy sector, said on Wednesday.
The survey found that 37 percent of Finns had a positive attitude towards nuclear power, up from 33 percent a year ago, Finergy said in a statement.
"The number of those with a positive attitude towards nuclear power exceeded those with a negative view," it said.
Of those polled, 32 percent now had a negative view, versus 35 percent a year ago, a Finergy spokesman said by telephone.
The poll was conducted at the end of April and early May for Finergy by Finnish Gallup, which surveyed 1,002 Finns of ages 15 and above.

It found attitudes towards nuclear power had grown warmer among supporters of the largest political parties, with the most pro-nuclear sentiment among supporters of the Conservative and Social Democratic parties.
Women continued to be more negative about nuclear power than men, but women too had grown more positive about this form of energy during the past year, Finergy said.
